name: section-helpers-solution
body:
PRE-IMPLEMENTATION SNAPSHOT (superseded) — the text below was authored before phase-01..phase-04 landed; its present-tense "Code anchors confirmed via the graph before authoring" claims are historical and are superseded by the UPDATE that follows. Original text follows verbatim:

Tier-3 reconciled for the layout-helper/source-context change. solution.component.renderer extended: owns the section/dict/list helpers, executes helper-invoked section templates bottom-up, builds the one-item .item (parent = the caller's fields), and exposes .raw/.data. solution.component.template-registry extended: the central function map is media/section/dict/list, and the load-time static section-helper checks (target exists and is section-usage, literal dict keys declared, required fields present/defaulted, min>0 child rejected) plus helper-call references in cycle rejection. solution.component.template-library-loader extended: step-3 layout parse uses the four-helper map and step-4 build checks include helper-call analysis and cycle inclusion. solution.component.markdown-validator notes the helper body is checked by the same body rules. Code anchors confirmed via the graph before authoring: internal/template/media.go (LayoutFuncMap — the single func-map source; the v1 helper is exactly media), internal/template/registry.go (ReservedNames = body/notes/deck/slide/item/_format; checkSections/checkFieldType/checkExample; Section.Walk cycle), internal/template/section.go (Section.Walk follows declared Sections only), internal/render/render.go (renderer.slideData/renderSection build the layout map; parseLayouts/reachableTemplates; itemContext; deckContext/slideContext; values/fieldValue — no .raw/.data and no section/dict/list helper today), internal/render/deck.go (whole-deck assembly, unchanged). No new code FQN is introduced: the change lands in files already anchored by these components. [autonomous]

UPDATE (2026-09-30) — current facts, each FQN/anchor checked against the code graph:

- The layout helper set is media/section/dict/list (template.LayoutFuncMap, internal/template/media.go:158-173; dict/list are built by template.DictFunc and template.ListFunc).
- template.ReservedNames includes raw and data alongside body/notes/deck/slide/item/_format (internal/template/registry.go:377-386).
- Implemented-by anchors added by the feedback-10 / feedback-11 reconciliations (both present in the graph):
  * solution.component.template-registry -> template.DictFunc, template.ListFunc (internal/template/media.go) and template.ResolveSectionCall, template.SectionCall, template.HelperCall, template.Section.HelperCalls, template.Section.HelperRefs (internal/template/section.go).
  * solution.component.template-library-loader -> template.exampleRawContext, template.exampleDataContext, template.exampleSectionHelper, template.checkLibraryExample (internal/template/examplecheck.go).
- Corrected helper ownership: the dict/list constructors and the central func map are anchored to solution.component.template-registry, not renderer; the renderer consumes the central map and binds only the section helper at render time. The render-time section execution units are renderer.sectionHelper, renderer.rawContext, renderer.dataContext and reachableTemplates, in internal/render/render.go — the file anchored to solution.component.renderer (renderer owns render.go at file level per solution.note.spine-backfill-reconcile; these units are now separately implemented-by-anchored, see solution.note.renderer-implementedby-anchors).
- See requirements.note.feedback-11-load-time-traceability and section-helpers/feedback-10.

PLANNED REFACTOR (2026-09-30, boy-scout pass before merge; no spec behaviour change) [with user]: the `.raw` and `.data` builders will be implemented once in `internal/template` and used by both the load-time example checking (`template.exampleRawContext`, `template.exampleDataContext` in internal/template/examplecheck.go) and the renderer (`renderer.rawContext`, `renderer.dataContext` in internal/render/render.go). Today the two halves are separate. The render-time units are the current implementation and are the ones anchored to solution.component.renderer; the shared `internal/template` builders do not exist yet and are not anchored — the plan declares them.
